Package control.session

Class Session

java.lang.Object
control.session.Session
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionListener, EventListener, ChangeListener
public class Session extends Object implements ActionListener, ChangeListener
This class holds big parts of both control and model part of the application. In other words this is more of an active session than probably expected. It co-manouvers , and is the interface with . Remember also that sits tightly within and contitutes a workpiece of the application's only which in large makes up the session. In brief: the session is a worklist of canvases with theorems in them and some panels that it updates according to what happens on the canvases.

    • Session

      public Session(String name, DeductionBase base)
      The session must have its data base from start and ande before something can happen in the modell it must be connected with it's panel.
      Parameters:
      name - Name of the session.
      base - The data base describing the theorems. The descripton parts most often generated on, in and by the canvas that contains the theorem. Except from composites which also have some layout information in the data base.
